name: Feature beats
summary: One feature per beat: big index number, brand icon chip, fitted title, one proof line. Slams in from alternating directions and clears before the next beat. Give each beat about 4 s.

params.items: [{ index?, title, proof, icon (Lucide name), mode?: 'right'|'left'|'up'|'down'|'zoom', maxSize? }]
params.cues: { at: [time per item], end: time the last beat clears }
params.modes: entrance modes cycled when an item has none
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

usage:
import * as feats from '../blocks/feature-beats/index.mjs';
const beats = feats.create(ctx, { items, cues: { at: CUE.features, end: CUE.payoff } });
changelog: v1 2026-09-26: extracted from the starter template

v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
